collectionMethods.name: GPS / GNSS
collectionMethods.provides: Location, route, heading, altitude, and some speed estimates
collectionMethods.caveat: Requires permission and a location receiver; indoor/urban readings can be inaccurate.

collectionMethods.name: IMU
collectionMethods.caveat: A generic IMU alone cannot reliably confirm a crash or occupant injury.

collectionMethods.name: TPMS
collectionMethods.caveat: Sensor coverage and thresholds are vehicle-specific; TPMS does not replace regular checks.

collectionMethods.name: Camera / driver-monitoring system
collectionMethods.provides: Lane, obstacle, sign, and driver-attention signals
collectionMethods.caveat: Needs validated, calibrated hardware and OEM-approved safety logic.

collectionMethods.name: Radar / ultrasonic
collectionMethods.provides: Relative distance, blind spot, and parking proximity
collectionMethods.caveat: Coverage and alert semantics depend on vehicle hardware and calibration.

collectionMethods.name: Additional IoT sensors
collectionMethods.provides: Cabin air, environment, water depth, and component condition
collectionMethods.caveat: Only available when the corresponding sensor is installed and calibrated.
